ideas.pitch: A low-latency acoustic sensor network running on edge devices that detects gunshots or explosions, extracts MFCC features, and streams precise geolocations to a tactical map for rapid military or border defense response.
ideas.title: AegisAudio: Edge Gunshot & Explosive Triangulation Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the national security and defense technologies theme of Hackify 3.0, following the proven architecture of past winners that handle live audio telemetry and spatial mapping.

ideas.pitch: An integrated web and mobile application that hooks into public or perimeter CCTV feeds, runs real-time face recognition against a classified database of threats, and instantly dispatches encrypted email alerts with snapshots to defense personnel.
ideas.title: SentinelCCTV: Automated Wanted Criminal & Intruder Watcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses cyber defence and civilian protection priorities by providing actionable, automated surveillance capabilities that judges in security-focused hackathons reward for practical field applicability.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight indoor mapping and location tracking web interface designed specifically for firefighters and rescue teams operating in signal-denied or collapsed buildings during post-war reconstruction and disaster zones.
ideas.title: BeaconFloor: Resilient Indoor Positioning for First Responders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical safety problem for humanitarian response and rebuilding operations, mirroring past winning tools built for emergency workers in hazardous environments.

ideas.pitch: A secure, zero-knowledge document transmission platform that acts like Snapchat for sensitive defense briefings and intelligence files, ensuring documents self-destruct after viewing and leave no forensic trail.
ideas.title: CryptoVault: Ephemeral Secure Document Exchange for Field Operatives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering in secure data handling with high-stakes operational utility, appealing to judges looking for robust cybersecurity and information protection measures.

ideas.pitch: A public transparency dashboard for post-war reconstruction funds and aid distribution where every resource allocation request carries a cryptographic seal that citizens and NGOs can independently audit.
ideas.title: AidLedger: Cryptographically Sealed Humanitarian Relief Tracking
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers clear measurable impact and public accountability for rebuilding nations, fulfilling the core ethos of transparent humanitarian governance highlighted in recent hackathon winners.
